arguments.summary: Critical incident involving a compromised finance workstation (WS-FIN-042) used as an initial access point via phishing. The attacker executed a Cobalt Strike beacon through an encoded PowerShell payload launched from Outlook, leading to lateral movement and C2 communication with a known malicious IP (198.51.100.23). Immediate containment actions included blocking the C2 IP at the firewall, full endpoint scanning, and execution of a hardening playbook. The original payload was falsely flagged as clean in sandboxing due to evasion techniques, highlighting a detection gap.
